planets.name: HIP 8152 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 8152 with a 19.6-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HIP 8152 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HIP 8152. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
